iso_retirement.comment:
The two languages are not inherently intelligible; the speakers of Sos Kundi
identify their language as different from Keak, similarly the speakers of Keak
identify their language as different to Sos Kundi; the lexical similarity of the
two languages is 68%; there is no common literature.
iso_retirement.name: Malinguat
iso_retirement.remedy: Split into Keak [keh] and Sos Kundi [sdk]
